source.paraphrase: Each business rule must have one declared owning domain module and rules document, and new callers must use that owner; a new owner requires an explicit domain-boundary justification rather than a dependency-cycle workaround.

invariants.why: Each business rule must have one declared owning domain module and rules document, and new callers must use that owner; a new owner requires an explicit domain-boundary justification rather than a dependency-cycle workaround.
invariants.fixHint: Bind PRACTICE-013 to a human-reviewed product assertion with scope, applicability, owner, evidence source and freshness controls in its rationale. Include a failing control. Run pregate fitness run PRACTICE-013; repair failed assertions. Review conditional applicability instead of returning an unexplained pass.
invariants.avoid: This is a project evidence gate, not a syntax detector or readiness certification. A receipt proves only the reviewed assertion ran on the current inputs. External legal, certification, deployment and performance evidence needs its own authenticity, scope and freshness checks inside that assertion. Missing evidence remains unverified. Pack fixtures test receipt admission, not the product requirement. Packs never supply executable commands.
